questions.prompt: When should a reviewed change be published?
questions.context:
This is a demonstration, not a project decision.

| Choice | Benefit | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Explicitly | Review before release | One extra action |
| Automatically | Immediate updates | Mistakes go live immediately |

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Edit --> Preview
  Preview --> Publish
```
questions.recommendation: Publish explicitly so editors can review changes.
